title: FTSE Russell Q3 2027 quarterly review takes effect at the open — IPO adds, buffered shares-in-issue and free-float updates, and the Russell US Style capping recap all implement after the 2027-09-17 quad-witching close
source: EST: owner-published standing rule, re-derived first-hand by this proposer rather than inherited. FTSE Russell, "Frequently Asked Questions — Russell US Equity Indexes", July 2026 (lseg.com dam policy-documents, ftse-faq-document-russell-us-equity-2026.pdf, HTTP 200, 198,134 bytes, 19 content streams inflated and text-extracted in-session 2026-09-09 — the byte and stream counts four sibling ledgers recorded, which is the check that this is the same edition). Its "Quarterly Addition Guidelines" table publishes the STANDING RULE rather than one year's dates: Rank Date "Last working day in January and July", Announce Date "Fourth Friday prior to the effective date (after market close)", Effective Date "Third Friday of the month". Its dated four-column schedule table, read at the column level this session, publishes for September 2026: Lock-Down Period (open of) 7 September, Russell US Style Capping Cut-Off 9 September, Review Effective Date (open of) 21 September. THE RULE REPRODUCES BOTH PUBLISHED QUARTERLY COLUMNS TO THE DAY: the third Fridays of March and September 2026 are 20 March and 18 September, giving review effective opens of Monday 23 March and Monday 21 September, both as published; the style capping cut-off is exactly twelve calendar days before the effective Monday in all FOUR published columns; and the lock-down opens fourteen calendar days before it in three of the four (June's is twenty-one, the reconstitution quarter's own longer window). SEPTEMBER 2027 THEREFORE READS: rank date Friday 2027-07-30 (the last working day in July 2027 — the 31st is a Saturday), announce Friday 2027-08-20 (the fourth Friday prior, after the close), implementation after the close of Friday 2027-09-17 — the third Friday, already tracked in this calendar as the CONFIRMED opex-2027-09-17 — effective at the open of Monday 2027-09-20, style capping cut-off Wednesday 2027-09-08, lock-down opening Monday 2027-09-06. A STRUCTURAL TELL THAT CORROBORATES THE LOCK-DOWN LEG: 2027-09-06 is Labor Day, and the owner's OWN published September 2026 lock-down date, 7 September 2026, was Labor Day 2026 — so the minus-fourteen rule is applied literally in this column without a holiday step, which is the one place a derived date could otherwise have drifted a session. The 2027 dates are RULE-DERIVED, NOT PUBLISHED: the FAQ's dated table carries 2026 columns only and closes "NOTE: Dates may be subject to change. Clients will be notified of any changes." Filed estimate on the standing counts: a proposal is estimate by contract, this lane never self-confirms an event it discovered in-sweep, and the confirmed-tier prefixes in market-events-data.ts have no member for an index owner's own published schedule. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-09-30, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-09-30 initial research (2026-09-09). IT IS THE PROPOSER'S OWN RESET, WHICH IS WHY IT IS FILED AND NOT DECLINED. The proposer's whole sheet rests on a cohort being recapped to 45% off the 2027-09-08 cut-off and that recap taking effect at this open; without this date the proposer's 13-session drift window has no left edge. The precedent is exact: the russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-12-31 lane filed russell-reconstitution-2027-12-10 for the identical reason one quarter later. THIS IS THE MISSING 2027 MEMBER OF A SERIES THIS CALENDAR ALREADY CARRIES, not a new class — russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-2026-09-21 and russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-2027-03-22 are the owner's other instances of the same review under the same rule. SCOPE, taken from the 2027-03-22 lane's correction rather than from the 2026-09-21 sibling: a quarterly review implements THREE things, not one — the IPO additions (from the 1 May to 31 July 2027 window under the July rank date), buffered quarterly shares-in-issue and free-float updates across existing constituents, and the Russell US Style capping recap struck at the 2027-09-08 cut-off. It carries NO cap-tier migration and NO style re-scoring; those are reconstitution legs. That distinction is exactly what makes the proposer's September window the family's control quarter. THE QUAD-WITCHING CORRIDOR IS RULE-CERTAIN, NOT A DRAW, and the 2027-03-22 lane established it as a class property rather than a property of one instance: because the effective open is always the Monday after the third Friday, every instance of this event lands on the first session after a quarterly expiration. The September 2027 corridor is unusually loaded even by that standard — this calendar independently tracks fomc-2027-09-15 (high; corroborated first-hand from federalreserve.gov's own FOMC calendar this session), vix-expiration-2027-09-15 and opex-2027-09-17 (high, confirmed) in the five sessions before this open. A TAKING LANE'S FIRST JOB: re-fetch the FTSE Russell FAQ and settle these dates against the owner's own 2027 column if one has been published by then; no owner document read on 2026-09-09 carries a 2027 column at all. Impact low and symbols deliberately EMPTY on this family's standing measured grounds, re-verified by the proposer this session: no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md re-grepped for rebalanc|reconstitution|russell|capping|index.flow|IWF|IWY, zero hits in both), and an ETF proxy in symbols would make the deterministic screen trip on mega-cap beta rather than on anything about this event.
